name: Dino Pet Walker
storyline: In a world where humans and dinosaurs live in harmony, the people made dinosaurs part of their routines and society. Everything is thought about humans an dinosaurs. Because that, the joy is the most interactive activity between people and their dino partners. But for you, your job isn't just beside dinosaurs, but bring them to to play, have fun and maybe... Don't let happen any mess... Right?
summary: Dino Pet Walker is a Fantasy Casual Game where you realize your childhood dream and play with your dinosaur pet. On this adventure, be ready for solve puzzles and have fun with your and another dino's in a voxel art enviroment, inspired by brazillians biomes.
